topic: Dividend / Payout Policy & Sustainability Taiwan PIT source contract

officialSourceEvidence.finding: Dividend distribution/non-distribution, changes, record-date decisions, ex-dividend payment-date changes and delayed payment are material-information disclosure events.
officialSourceEvidence.pitImplication: Board/shareholder decision, record date, ex-date and payment date must be separate event clocks.

officialSourceEvidence.finding: Dividend/benefit record-date and cash-dividend payment-date reporting has an explicit advance reporting requirement relative to book-closure.
officialSourceEvidence.pitImplication: Record-date/payment scheduling is not interchangeable with the earlier dividend decision timestamp.

officialSourceEvidence.finding: Current disclosures expose decision date, dividend type/amount, ex-date, record date and cash payment date; per-share cash amount can be revised when outstanding shares change.
officialSourceEvidence.pitImplication: Dividend amount must be versioned; share-count/corporate-action changes can alter per-share payout after the initial decision.

mechanism: Payout sustainability is a cash-source and balance-sheet question, not a high-yield ranking rule.
Earnings coverage, CFO/FCF coverage, retention and leverage can jointly constrain future payout capacity.
Proposal/board decision/final approval/ex-date/payment are distinct information and cash-flow clocks.
counterEvidenceAndAlternativeExplanation: High dividend yield can be caused by price collapse rather than payout quality.
High payout can be rational for mature low-reinvestment firms and dangerous for cyclical/high-capex firms.
Dividend cuts can preserve solvency and improve long-run value; they are not mechanically bearish.
Stable DPS can be debt-funded or reserve-funded and therefore is not sufficient evidence of sustainability.
Per-share dividend revisions can reflect share-count changes rather than deterioration in total cash distribution.
failureConditions: Historical first-known timestamps cannot be replayed.
Dividend source (earnings/retained earnings/capital reserve) is not separable.
Cash dividend and stock dividend are conflated.
Financial institutions are evaluated without D07-32 regulatory-capital semantics.
Outcome data influences sample selection, threshold choice or event-clock definition.
antiBiasGates: OOS and walk-forward only after source replay
selection-bias guard including cutters/suspenders and delisted cases
exactNextContinuationPoint: Build a multi-company multi-date historical MOPS/TWSE append-only replay that preserves proposal/board/final/ex-date/payment clocks, dividend source, total/per-share revisions and share-count basis. Include cutters/suspenders and unchanged payers. Keep outcomes closed until the replay passes PIT and survivorship checks.
